s.note: Honey butter popcorn and flaky salt. Wade was born after the corn syrup droughts.
s.how: Heat the oil in a large lidded pot, add the corn, cover and shake until the popping stops. Melt the butter with the honey until bubbling. Toss through the popcorn with the salt.

s.note: Hot sauce wings with blue cheese dip.
s.how: Pat the wings dry, toss with the baking powder and salt and lay on a rack over a tray. Bake at 220C, turning once, until crisp and golden. Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream and mayo. Melt the butter into the hot sauce and toss the wings through, then serve with celery and dip.
shop: 1kg chicken wings, tips off and halved@Meat

m.note: Thai green curry, beans and jasmine rice.
m.how: Fry the curry paste in a splash of the coconut milk until fragrant. Add the chicken and stir until coated, then pour in the rest of the coconut milk. Simmer with the beans and zucchini until the chicken is cooked. Season with fish sauce, sugar and lime and stir through the basil. Serve with the jasmine rice.

m.note: Two smashed patties, cheese, pickles and fries.
m.how: Bake the chips at 220C until crisp. Mix the mayo, tomato sauce and mustard into a burger sauce. Roll the mince into 8 balls, smash thin on a hot griddle with onion and cook 2 minutes a side, cheese on top. Toast the buns and stack two patties each with pickles and sauce.

w.note: Chocolate egg with salted caramel and gold dust.
w.how: Melt two thirds of the chocolate, take off the heat and stir in the rest until glossy. Brush into 8 half-egg moulds in two coats and chill until set. Cook the sugar to deep amber, whisk in the cream, butter and salt and cool. Unmould, fill the halves with ice cream and caramel, join and brush with gold dust.

d.note: Cherry cola over vanilla ice cream. The Curator's coin is an extra life.
d.how: Put two scoops of ice cream in each of 4 tall glasses. Pour the cola slowly down the side and top with cherries.
